summary: A weekly Wednesday-night ($5) country line dance class at Eda's Hide-a-Way, a Weaverville bar, taught by an instructor named Kristey with separate beginner and advanced hours. Listings and the venue's own event page frame it as instruction ('get yourselves primed and ready for the dance floor at our weekend shows') rather than a club, with no membership, dues, sign-up, named regulars, or dedicated group social page found.

evidence.note: Listings describe 'beginner and advanced classes that are open to everyone,' i.e. an open instructed class, not membership language.

Venue's own events page confirms it runs every Wednesday 6-9pm, $5 entry, first hour beginner instruction, explicitly framed as prep for the venue's weekend shows -- no mention of Kristey's background or a member community.
Web search for 'Kristey' plus Asheville/Weaverville/line dance turned up no dedicated website, Facebook group, Instagram, or 'about' page for this specific class or instructor.

A similarly named 'Country Line Dance Lessons with Kristy' also appears as a separate bar event (Happy Basset Barrel House), consistent with a traveling instructor teaching paid classes at multiple venues rather than one fixed community.
